name: AI Post Summarizer Lite
author: R. Sabbir

sections.description:
Unlock the power of AI on your blog with AI Post Summarizer Lite. This plugin adds a sleek, modern summary button to your posts, allowing visitors to instantly generate a summary of your content. It will save your users time and provide them with immediate value.

By making your site AI-powered, you get a step forward from your competitors and offer a cutting-edge user experience. Our plugin is designed to be incredibly simple to set up. With no API keys required, it works entirely on the client-side, meaning no complicated setup or costs for you.

The included button is fully responsive and designed to look great on any device or theme. Give your readers a new way to interact with your content and see why thousands are turning to AI to make their blogs more dynamic.

Features

  • One-Click Summaries: Let users summarize any post instantly with their preferred AI tool.
  • No API Keys Needed: 100% client-side operation means no server costs and no complex setup.
  • GDPR Compliant & Private: No user data is collected, stored, or transmitted.
  • Fully Responsive: The summary button looks great on all devices, from desktops to smartphones.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Optimized for performance with minimal impact on your site’s speed.
  • Display Settings: Simple options to control the position and appearance of the summary button.
  • Easy to Use: Simply install, activate, and you’re done. No coding required.
  • Translation Ready: Full internationalization support.

How It Works

The plugin adds a summary button to your posts. When a visitor clicks it, the plugin intelligently creates a special link that opens a new tab to their favorite AI service (like ChatGPT) with a pre-filled prompt asking it to summarize the content of your post. The entire process happens in the user’s browser, ensuring privacy and zero server load.

Benefits

  • Save Your Readers’ Time: Long articles can be intimidating. A summary gives readers the key takeaways instantly.
  • Boost User Engagement: Providing a useful tool like this keeps users on your site longer and encourages interaction.
  • Modernize Your Website: Show your audience that your site is on the cutting edge of technology.
  • Increase Content Accessibility: Summaries can help users with learning disabilities or those who are short on time to understand their content.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for “AI Post Summarizer Lite”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. (Optional) Go to the AI Summarizer Lite menu in your dashboard to access Settings & Customization and adjust the button’s display position and style.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin .zip file from WordPress.org.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click Upload Plugin and select the .zip file you downloaded.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Quick Setup

  1. After activation, the AI Summary Button will automatically appear on your posts.
  2. Visit any single post page to see the new button in action!
  3. That’s it! There are no API keys or complicated settings to configure.
sections.faq:
1. How does this plugin work without an API key?

The plugin cleverly constructs a special link. When a user clicks the button, it opens their chosen AI tool in a new browser tab and automatically passes in the instruction to summarize your article’s content. The user uses their own account with the AI service.

2. Is this plugin really free to use?

Yes, 100% free. Because it works client-side, there are no API costs for you to worry about.

3. Can I change the style or position of the button?

Yes, the Lite version includes basic settings to adjust the button’s position and appearance to best fit your theme.

4. What is the difference between the Lite and Pro versions?

The Lite version is a great way to start, offering summaries for one AI platform. The Pro version will be a complete engagement toolkit, supporting 6+ AI platforms, offering an Advanced Design Engine, a Smart Prompt Library, and a built-in analytics dashboard.

5. When will the Pro version be released?

It’s coming very soon! We are putting the final touches on it to ensure it’s the most powerful and user-friendly summary plugin on the market.

6. Will I be able to upgrade easily from Lite to Pro?

Absolutely. We will provide a smooth upgrade path. When you install the Pro version, it will automatically handle the transition.

7. Is the plugin compatible with my theme?

Yes. The plugin is designed to be lightweight and follows WordPress best practices to ensure maximum compatibility with all popular themes, including Astra, Hello Elementor, OceanWP, GeneratePress, and Kadence.

8. Is it compatible with caching plugins?

Yes! The plugin works seamlessly with WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, WP Super Cache, Autoptimize, LiteSpeed Cache, and other major caching solutions because of its client-side nature.

9. Do you offer support for the Lite version?

We provide basic support through the WordPress.org support forums. Dedicated priority support will be available for Pro users.

10. Does this use my server’s resources to generate summaries?

No. The plugin is 100% client-side. It sends the request from the user’s browser directly to the AI service, so it puts zero load on your web server.

11. What AI model is used for the summary?

The plugin directs the user to a third-party AI service like ChatGPT. The summary quality is determined by the specific model that service is using at the time (e.g., GPT-3.5, GPT-4, etc.).

12. Will using this plugin improve my SEO?

While the primary benefit is user experience, improved engagement metrics like time-on-page can positively influence SEO rankings. It signals to search engines that visitors find your content valuable.

13. Can the AI misunderstand or misinterpret my article?

AI is powerful but not perfect. The quality of a summary can depend on the article’s complexity and the AI model’s capabilities. The Lite version uses a default prompt to guide the AI.
